issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Anysite.io
products.tagline: Build and enrich B2B lists by chatting to your agent
products.summaryZh: 通过与你的代理对话来构建和丰富B2B列表
products.descriptionZh: Anysite.io 是一个 B2B 数据层，内嵌于你常用的 AI 智能体中。向智能体索取所需列表——按地区、行业和规模筛选的公司、公司内的人员、他们当前的职位和邮箱——Anysite.io 即可返回结果。无需编写查询，无需维护爬虫。可通过 MCP 或 REST API 在 Claude、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 及其他智能体中使用。接入后当天即可启动你的外呼数据采集。
products.description: Anysite.io is a B2B data layer living in your favorite AI agent. Ask your agent for the list you need — companies by geo, industry, and size; the people inside them; their current job titles and emails — and Anysite.io returns it. No queries to write, no scrapers to maintain. Works over MCP or REST API inside Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other agents. Plug in and launch your outbound data collection the same day.

products.name: Loqua
products.tagline: Speak naturally and move from thoughts to being done
products.summaryZh: 自然地表达，从思考走向完成
products.descriptionZh: 你的想法不该因为键盘而慢下来。有了 Loqua，你可以自然地说话，把粗略的想法变成可直接使用的文字，理解屏幕上的内容，在不想阅读时改为聆听，并通过语音推进工作——从改写和翻译到日程安排和编码工作流。更少打字，更少上下文切换，更多时间保持心流。
products.description: Your thoughts shouldn’t have to slow down for a keyboard. With Loqua, you can speak naturally to turn rough ideas into ready-to-use writing, understand what’s on your screen, listen when you’d rather not read, and move work forward by voice - from rewriting and translation to scheduling and coding workflows. Less typing, less context switching, more time in flow.

products.name: Wisry
products.tagline: Clone the ads already winning in your market, at scale
products.summaryZh: 大规模克隆市场上已经成功的广告
products.descriptionZh: AI智能体全程自动执行：扫描Meta和TikTok广告库，找出你所在市场中已经胜出的广告，将其克隆为你的品牌静态和视频广告，并投放到Meta和Google，以ROAS为优化目标。胜出的广告，无需猜测。
products.description: AI agents that run the whole play: scan the Meta and TikTok ad libraries for the ads already winning in your market, clone them into your brand as static and video ads, and launch to Meta and Google, optimized for ROAS. Winning ads, without the guesswork.

products.name: Raycast 2.0
products.tagline: The next generation of Raycast is here
products.summaryZh: 新一代 Raycast 已到来
products.descriptionZh: Raycast 2.0 基于全新基础构建，由内而外重新设计。你的快捷入口现已融入可在各应用间执行操作的 AI、用于周期性任务的自动化功能，以及将进行中的工作整合在一起的项目。连接你自己的 ChatGPT 或 Claude 账户，让 AI 与你日常使用的命令和扩展协同工作。最出色的启动器变得更出色了。
products.description: Raycast 2.0 is built on a new foundation, redesigned from the inside out. Your shortcut to everything now brings AI that can take action across your apps, Automations for recurring tasks, and Projects to keep ongoing work together. Connect your own ChatGPT or Claude account and put AI to work alongside the commands and extensions you use every day. The best Launcher got even better.

products.name: Cline Desktop App
products.tagline: An open-source app for open-weight models
products.summaryZh: 一个面向开放权重模型的开源应用
products.descriptionZh: Cline Desktop 提供一个开源工作空间，让你最喜爱的模型投入工作——运行多个智能体会话、自动化重复性任务、通过 Cline 市场扩展其能力，并延续 Claude Code 和 Codex 等智能体的工作。选择最适合你的模型和提供商，而 Cline 为开放权重模型优化的智能体框架则驱动其背后的工作。这一切都不受封闭生态系统的束缚。
products.description: Cline Desktop gives you an open-source workspace to put your favourite model to work - run multiple agent sessions, automate recurring tasks, extend their capabilities through Cline’s Marketplace, and continue work from agents like Claude Code and Codex. Choose the models and providers that work best for you, while Cline’s agent harness, optimized for open-weight models, powers the work behind them. All without being tied to a closed ecosystem.

products.name: easyspecs.ai
products.tagline: The spec review platform
products.summaryZh: 规格审查平台
products.descriptionZh: 1.5倍与100倍之间的差距不是速度，而是信任！AI代理生成代码的速度是人工编写的100倍。但你的团队无法全部审查。EasySpecs为未记录的代码库编写文档，并将其转化为可信的规范，让规范审查成为你新的合并请求审查。让你的代理立足于现实。无需时刻盯守即可扩展代理式开发。一次性记录基础。审查包括Oracles和Rubrics在内的规范，并交付你真正验证过的代码。
products.description: The gap between 1.5x and 100x isn't speed, it's trust!! AI agents generate code 100x faster than humans write it. But your team can't review it all. EasySpecs documents undocumented codebases and turns them into trustworthy specifications, so spec review becomes your new merge request review. Ground your agents in reality. Scale agentic development without babysitting. Document the foundation once. Review specs including Oracles and Rubrics and Ship code you actually verified.

products.name: Sliick
products.tagline: Free 3D mockups for your screenshots and videos
products.summaryZh: 为你的截图和视频提供免费3D模型
products.descriptionZh: 在浏览器中直接将截图和视频转化为精美的3D设备模型。选择场景，自定义形状和颜色，调整相机视角，添加动态效果。免费导出图像或视频，无需账户，无水印。您的媒体文件保留在您的设备上。由Liinks制作。
products.description: Turn screenshots and videos into beautiful 3D device mockups, right in your browser. Choose a scene, customize shapes and colors, adjust the camera, and add motion. Export images or videos for free, with no account or watermark. Your media stays on your device. Made by Liinks.

products.name: Devin Voice
products.tagline: You say it, Devin ships it
products.summaryZh: 你说，Devin 来实现。
products.descriptionZh: Devin Voice 让你与 Cognition 的 AI 软件工程师 Devin 对话，由它来完成工作。说出任务，Devin 便会规划、编码并交付。由 GPT-Live 驱动自然对话，底层采用 Cognition 全新的 SWE-2 编码模型。前往 https://devin.ai 体验 Devin。
products.description: Devin Voice lets you talk to Devin, Cognition's AI software engineer, and have it ship the work. Speak a task out loud and Devin plans, codes, and delivers. Powered by GPT-Live for natural conversation, with Cognition's new SWE-2 coding model under the hood. Try Devin at https://devin.ai.

products.name: Moji
products.tagline: Open Markdown files like PDFs.
products.summaryZh: 像PDF一样打开Markdown文件。
products.descriptionZh: 像打开文档一样打开 Markdown：快速、干净、无干扰。Moji 是一款轻量级阅读器和编辑器，适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，支持实时预览、Mermaid 图表，以及 PDF、HTML 和 PNG 导出。
products.description: Open Markdown like a document: fast, clean, and distraction-free. Moji is a lightweight reader and editor for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with live preview, Mermaid diagrams, and PDF, HTML, and PNG export.

products.name: ChatHop
products.tagline: Take your conversation anywhere.
products.summaryZh: 随时随地畅聊。
products.descriptionZh: 在思考过程中将你的AI对话转移到另一个助手，上下文一并保留。以纯文本或Markdown格式复制整个聊天记录。每月可免费使用20次。
products.description: Move your AI conversation to another assistant mid-thought, context included. Copy the whole chat as plain text or Markdown. Start with 20 free uses every month.

products.name: chat-recall
products.tagline: Ctrl+F for every conversation you've had with an AI
products.summaryZh: 在每一次与AI的对话中按Ctrl+F查找
products.descriptionZh: 你的团队已经用 AI 助手做了好几个月的工作。Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 OpenCode 各自以自己格式保存了完整记录，彼此都无法读取。一条命令就能读取它们写下的内容，并将其转化为一份可搜索的历史记录。密码会在任何内容离开你的电脑之前被剔除。你的助手会自行搜索它，因此不再追问你上个月决定了什么。它还能找出泄露到旧聊天中的密钥，并检查哪些仍然有效。
products.description: Your team has done months of work with AI assistants. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode each keep a full record of it, in its own format, and none can read the others. One command reads what they wrote and turns it into one searchable history. Passwords come out before anything leaves your computer. Your assistant searches it itself, so it stops asking what you decided last month. It also finds keys that leaked into old chats, and checks which still work.

products.name: sizeless
products.tagline: Spatial AI for underground infrastructure
products.summaryZh: 地下基础设施的空间人工智能
products.descriptionZh: sizeless 将一段用智能手机拍摄的开放沟槽视频，转化为公用事业公司和承包商依法必须提交的文档：3D 模型、CAD/BIM 图纸，以及他们据以计费的工程量。如今，这需要耗时数月并聘请测量员。我们只需数小时，用施工队自己拍摄的视频即可完成。
products.description: sizeless turns a smartphone video of an open trench into the documentation utilities and contractors are legally required to produce: a 3D model, CAD/BIM plans, and the quantities they bill from. Today that takes months and a surveyor. We do it in hours, from a video the crew films themselves.

products.name: Design Studio by Monday Merch
products.tagline: A browser canvas to design merch with over 1.000+ products
products.summaryZh: 一个浏览器画布，可用1000多种产品设计周边商品
products.descriptionZh: 想象一下Figma，但专为创造实体产品而设。Design Studio让你直接在产品上设计：超过1000种商品，每个角度均支持2D查看（部分产品更可3D预览）。一键添加品牌中心，即刻生成设计。印刷规则与要求已内置，确保每个设计都能直接投入生产。当然，分享与协作也同样便捷。
products.description: Think Figma, but for creating real products. Design Studio lets you design straight on the product: 1,000+ items, every angle in 2D (and selected products in 3D). Add your brand hub with a click to create designs instantly. Printing rules and requirements are baked in, so every design is ready for production. And of course, easily share and collaborate.

products.name: Cadenya
products.tagline: A hosted agentic loop to bring agentic possibilities to life
products.summaryZh: 托管式智能体循环，让智能体的可能性成为现实
products.descriptionZh:
Cadenya 不是一个可以随意接入应用栈的框架，而是一个托管的智能体循环。你使用已经熟悉的规范（如 OpenAPI 和 MCP）连接工具，Cadenya 会为你运行智能体。开箱即用，它处理：

* 上下文压缩
* 工具审批
* Webhooks 和 SSE 流式传输
* 可嵌入组件
* 四种语言的 SDK

它不限定模型。将其指向 OpenRouter 或任何兼容 OpenAI 的端点，它就会使用该端点进行推理。发送邮件至 support@cadenya.com 可获取免费一个月。
products.description: Cadenya is not a framework you bolt into your application stack. It's a hosted agentic loop. You connect tools using specs you already know, like OpenAPI and MCP, and Cadenya runs the agent for you. Out of the box it handles: * Context compaction * Tool approvals * Webhooks and SSE streaming * Embeddable widgets * SDKs in four languages It's model-agnostic. Point it at OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and it uses that for inference. Email support@cadenya.com to get a free month.

products.name: GLYPH Immersive
products.tagline: a free tool for modular grid lettering
products.summaryZh: 一个用于模块化网格字体的免费工具
products.descriptionZh: 在可调节网格上绘制圆角像素字形和形状。可控制间距、圆角和边缘，并支持免费导出。无需注册，在浏览器中运行。
products.description: Draw rounded-pixel letterforms and shapes on an adjustable grid. Controls for spacing, corners and edges, plus free export. No signup, runs in browser.

products.name: Accordio
products.tagline: Give Claude the admin tools is missing
products.summaryZh: 给Claude提供所缺少的管理工具
products.descriptionZh: Claude 缺少的工具：记录时间、签署合同、发送发票、收款。适用于 Claude、Claude Code 及任何代理的免费 MCP 连接器。
products.description: The tools Claude is missing: track time, sign contracts, send invoices, get paid. Free MCP connector for Claude, Claude Code, and any agent.

products.name: Jackalope
products.tagline: Codex, Claude Code, Grok, + OpenCode in one shared workspace
products.summaryZh: Codex、Claude Code、Grok 与 OpenCode 共用一个共享工作区
products.descriptionZh: Jackalope 将 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 和 OpenCode 整合到一个共享工作区中。在并行的 Git worktree 中运行任务，将项目上下文集中在一起，并在应用更改前进行审查。Jackalope 负责寻找最佳模型、提供 MCP 工具与共享上下文、跟踪用量与配额、管理任意 agent 及多个账户（工作/个人）、周期性任务、代码库可视化、计算机操作、浏览器操作等。跨平台，开源。立即加入抢先体验名单，
products.description: Jackalope brings Codex, Claude Code, Grok, and OpenCode into one shared workspace. Run tasks in parallel Git worktrees, keep project context together, and review changes before applying them. Jackalope handles finding the best model, providing MCP tooling / shared context, tracking usage & quotas, managing any agent and multiple accounts (work / personal), recurring tasks, codebase visualization, computer use, browser use, and more. Cross-platform, open-source. Join the early-access list now,

products.name: Formesign
products.tagline: Add legally binding signature to your Google Form
products.summaryZh: 为 Google 表单添加具有法律约束力的签名
products.descriptionZh: Google Forms 擅长从用户那里收集数据，但不具备收集签名的选项。Formesign 为你已构建的表单添加电子签名。用户可在任何设备上签名，所有人都会通过电子邮件收到已签署的 PDF，一份可供审计的副本会保存到 Drive，回复内容则同步到 Sheets。
products.description: Google Forms is great at collecting data from your users, but doesn't have the option to collect signatures. Formesign adds eSignature to the form you already built. Users sign on any device, everyone gets the signed PDF by email, an audit-ready copy saves to Drive, and responses sync to Sheets.

products.name: Spaces
products.tagline: One shared space where your team and AI agents work
products.summaryZh: 一个共享空间，让团队与 AI 智能体协同工作
products.descriptionZh: Spaces 是一款桌面应用，让团队及其 AI 智能体为每个项目共享一个空间——共享聊天、文件和定时例程。可使用任何 LLM 提供商——ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini——或在你自己的机器上运行本地模型。免费开始使用。
products.description: Spaces is a desktop app where your team and their AI agents share one space per project — shared chats, files, and scheduled routines. Use any LLM provider — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini — or run local models on your own machine. Free to start.

products.name: TIM PG
products.tagline: Anonymize sensitive data before pasting into AI tools
products.summaryZh: 在粘贴到AI工具之前，先匿名化敏感数据
products.descriptionZh: TIM PG 是一款严格离线、100% 无 AI 的 Windows 实用工具。它能在你将剪贴板内容粘贴到 LLM 之前自动遮蔽个人数据，并无缝地将敏感数据还原到 AI 的回复中。具备文档匿名化（PDF、Office）和 Smart Bubble 技术，可在你的 PC 本地保护文本片段。无云端，无数据泄露——只为你的工作流程提供安全的本地数据隐私保护。
products.description: TIM PG is a strictly offline, 100% AI-free Windows utility. It automatically masks personal data from your clipboard before you paste it into LLMs, and seamlessly restores the sensitive data back into the AI's response. Features document anonymization (PDF, Office) and Smart Bubble technology to protect text segments locally on your PC. No cloud, no leaked data—just secure local data privacy for your workflows.
